projects.title: Svg Number Plate Editor
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Form + Template Processor
projects.description:
Project Overview

SVG Edit is an AI powered automation system that dynamically generates and edits SVG templates based on user form submissions. The system validates input using an AI agent, processes SVG files programmatically, and delivers customized production ready SVG outputs automatically via email.

Problem It Solves

Manually editing SVG templates for client specific designs is time consuming and error prone. This system eliminates repetitive design modifications by automating the entire pipeline from input validation to SVG processing and delivery.

How It Works

Form Submission Trigger
The workflow starts when a user submits a form with required design details.

AI-Based Text Verification
An AI Agent (Google Gemini Chat Model) validates and structures the input data using a structured output parser to ensure clean and reliable processing.

Dynamic Variable Handling
The system sets editing variables and retrieves the correct SVG template ID dynamically.

Template Retrieval
The SVG template is downloaded automatically from Google Drive.

Programmatic SVG Processing
Using function nodes, the system modifies SVG elements (text, values, attributes) based on user input and merges the processed data with the template.

Final Merge & Output Generation
The edited SVG file is compiled and prepared for delivery.

Automated Delivery
The processed SVG is automatically sent to the user via email.

Key Features

AI powered input validation and structuring

Fully automated SVG template editing

Dynamic template selection

API based file handling

Production grade workflow architecture

Zero manual intervention

Scalable and reusable automation pipeline

Impact

Reduced manual design workload

Improved accuracy in template customization

Faster turnaround time for SVG based assets

Production ready automation for real client use cases

projects.title: Low Margin Report
projects.subtitle: Automated Profit & Margin Monitoring System
projects.description:
Low Margin Report is a fully automated reporting system designed to monitor product profitability, identify low margin orders, and generate structured daily business reports without manual intervention. The workflow runs on a scheduled basis, processes sales and cost data, calculates profit margins, and delivers actionable insights automatically.

Problem It Solves

Manually tracking low margin products and calculating profitability across orders is time consuming and prone to errors. Businesses often fail to detect underperforming products in time. This automation ensures real time visibility into profit metrics and highlights low margin risks automatically.

Key Features

Automated daily reporting
Dynamic profit & margin calculations
Low margin detection logic
Loop based order processing
Structured data transformation
Zero manual reporting effort
Scalable architecture for growing order volume
Business Impact
Early detection of low profit products
Improved pricing and cost control decisions
Reduced manual reporting workload
Faster financial insights for decision makers

projects.title: ShipStation Shipped Orders Margin Automation
projects.subtitle: Webhook-Driven E-commerce Margin Calculation & Order Processing System
projects.description:
Designed and deployed an end-to-end automation workflow that processes shipped orders from ShipStation via webhook, calculates profit margins, normalizes order data, and routes it through structured business logic pipelines. The system eliminates manual reporting, ensures real-time margin visibility, and integrates with multiple services for seamless post-shipment processing.

This workflow handles complex branching logic, conditional flows, API integrations, and automated data transformations to support scalable e-commerce operations.
